segments: "THE BLACK HOLE" in bold white text fades in on a black screen, then quickly fades out
"THE BLACK HOLE" appears in bold white text on a black screen. A circle opens up to reveal an office setting
The copy machine prints out a solid black circle on a large white sheet of paper
The man reaches for a drink from a styrofoam cup.  For an instant, the camera is in perspective of the black hole looking at the man with a rumbling noise in the background
The man, bewildered that the cup is gone, frowns at the black hole
The man picks up the piece of paper, holding it at eye level. He reaches his hand into it before pulling it back out
The man walks up to a vending machine, placing the black hole up on the glass
We see an office door that says "keep out". The camera slowly zooms in on the door
The man walks in, seeing a large safe
The man sticks his arms and head into the hole, climbing in with his whole body
The camera pans out as we hear a faint knocking sound on the safe
